BESPOKE PAINTING & DECORATING

Andrew Farkas Limited (AFL) quality painting & decorating are based in Harrow, Middlesex. We cover the London and Home County areas. Established in 1992, a client centred business, fully insured and achieving the highest standards of professional quality.

Request a Quotation >
DECORATING SERVICES WE OFFER
Interior Decorating

Whether you are looking to redecorate your entire property, or just want a freshen up in a few rooms. AFL Decorators are the local decorators of choice, from design/colour ideas, right through to aftercare and touchups.

Learn More
Exterior Decorating

Our experienced team are able to assist with both large and small exterior decorating. From woodwork fixes and touchups through to entire property painting, we have the tools and knowledge to ensure a professional finish.

Learn More
Schools & Commercial Decorating

Tired or dated exterior? It is amazing what a colour change or freshen up can do to the exterior of any property. AFL Decorators takes care of everything, from filling wholes to painting the full exterior, with minimal disruption.

Learn More
Experienced Professional Decorators

When it comes to painting and decorating in the Greater London area, look no further than AFL Decorators.

Request a Quotation 

What Our Customers Say

“We had three rooms painted and some carpentry to box in a new boiler, and everything was completed to our satisfaction in three and a half days. Our experience was very good, from initial approach to completion of work. The estimated cost and time it would take was accurate and good value – in fact the work was finished half a day earlier than expected. The two painters were considerate, efficient and hard-working. We were very pleased with the results. It is the second time we have used this company.”

Greater London Customer - Which? Trusted Trader
    

“He was very polite and helpful and, because the coronavirus was restricting visits at the time, I sent him photos of the three rooms for his consideration. I received an estimate shortly afterwards, and I was pleased to accept it. The work was carried out to the highest standard and I was delighted by it. His team were quick and highly efficient and, painting unattended in my Flat, they were scrupulously honest and trustworthy. I will be inviting them back again next year to decorate my living room which now needs doing. Andrew and his team were a pleasure to deal with, helpful and respectful, and I have no hesitation in recommending them.”

Turn to Andrew Farkas Limited for all kinds of painting and decorating services in Harrow, North West London, and the surrounding areas. From interior painting and wallpapering to exterior plastering and repairs, our company provides a huge array of services for domestic and commerical clients alike.

Established 1992
Fully insured to £5 million
